messages:
maria: Hey @sam @kevin — opened PR 44731. Small change to the hot-path KV fallback to avoid a blocking memcpy when seqlen < 64. Affects runtime fallback path and might change eviction pressure. Can I get quick eyes from runtime + infra + security? Planning a short canary tomorrow 09:00 PT for ~30m. Diff: https://git.redwood/44731

sam: looking now. quick question — do you have microbench numbers for tail latency? even small copies can spike p99 for short sequences

maria: pasted a short microbench below, numbers are median / p95 / p99 (tokens/sec). baseline vs this change:
```
baseline: 1200 / 980 / 720
patch:    1218 / 990 / 735
```
small win on median, tiny bump on p99 but within our SLO envelope in local tests.

kevin: skimming code. main infra concern is pinned-memory churn during canary bursts, could amplify OOM risk if fallback is more aggressive. can you include an eviction-safety knob for the canary? cc @jess

jess: +1 to kevin. canary should run in the low-traffic slot (we have 09:00 PT open, but prefer 10:30 PT if it reduces overlap with batch jobs). also need to mark the canary with the "eviction-safety" feature flag so we can revert quickly.

maria: ok — will add a feature flag and an eviction_threshold override for the canary. schedule -> 10:30 PT then.

angela: quick security note: this touches shared allocator/fallthrough codepath. not expecting new attack surface but request a short design note in the PR describing why memcpy removal is safe and how we validate no info leakage. also please attach the unit test run and logs for canary.

maria: will add design blurb + unit tests. also adding a metric so we can monitor traffic hitting the fallback path: `kv_fallback_copy_bytes_total`.

sam: can you also emit a gauge for fallback latency? `kv_fallback_latency_ms_bucket` or histogram is fine. that helped us catch regressions in the last rollout.

maria: will add histogram + a dashboard panel.

kevin: infra +1 after the feature flag and threshold override are in. can we gate merge on a green e2e with the flag enabled?

maria: yes — I'll add a merge gate to require canary-success label and an ops signoff.

ops-bot: scheduled canary slot request created -> 2024-04-27 10:30 PT (slot id: canary-20240427-37). Reply with `ops-bot: approve` to confirm.

jess: `ops-bot: approve` :thumbsup:

sam: quick review done. small nit in comment docs, otherwise LGTM once metrics are added.

angela: security ack pending design blurb + unit test logs. will re-review after that.

maria: thanks — pushing a follow-up commit with feature flag, thresholds, metrics and a short design note now. will tag when ready for final thumbs. :raised_hands:

sam: thanks, ping me after you tag — I can do the final approval quickly.

kevin: likewise, happy to fast-track infra signoff once the canary config is in PR.

maria: tag: diff updated, tests passing in CI, design note added in PR description, feature flag `kv_fallback_canary` in place.

sam: LGTM :shipit:

kevin: infra LGTM — will watch the canary metrics and stand by to rollback if eviction_rate > 0.5%

angela: security acked after logs looked clean. :white_check_mark:

maria: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll merge after the 10:30 PT canary starts and we see green for 30m. I'll post results here and the canary dashboard link.

jess: nice work — appreciate the quick coordination. :clap:
